literal_meaning: এত (so much) এত (so much) – repetition for emphasis on quantity
figurative_meaning_en: In abundant quantities; heaps or profusely
example_sentences_in_bangla: এত এত ফল কিনেছো, কোথায় রাখবে?
এত এত ভালোবাসা দেখিয়ে কী লাভ?
example_sentences_in_english: You've bought so many fruits, where will you keep them?
What's the point of showing so much love?
note: Often used in everyday Bengali speech to emphasize excess; referenced in popular songs like 'Laghu Geeti' for illustrative purposes
